Trigger on: evaluate / benchmark / score a model, throughput / latency / QPS / stress test, find benchmarks, view results, 评测模型, 压测, 跑 benchmark, 性能测试, 查看评测结果, 有哪些评测集, RAG 评测, embedding 评测. Do NOT trigger for: model training / finetuning / deployment / serving requests.
skills.name: skill-evalscope
